# RefurbMe

> > RefurbMe is a price comparison platform for certified refurbished Apple products across multiple retailers, helping buyers find the best deals on MacBooks, iPhones, iPads, and accessories.

RefurbMe aggregates refurbished Apple device listings from major retailers like Back Market, Amazon, Apple Store, Gazelle, and plug. The platform enables side-by-side price comparisons, warranty details, and condition grades across refurbishers to help consumers make informed purchasing decisions on certified pre-owned electronics.

## Key Topics

- Price comparison
- Certified refurbished
- Warranty & return policy
